channel.title: Sao Tome and Principe - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Sao Tome and Principe, every source cited.

item.title: Kosmos Energy donates 10 ambulances to Sao Tome and Principe health ministry
item.description: The vehicles will bolster the national health system's response capacity and improve patient transport.

item.title: Sao Tome suspends climate and water project tenders
item.description: The PRIASA III project unit and the National Water Institute have halted three calls for expressions of interest.

item.title: Sao Tome and Principe, Angola sign higher education quality accord
item.description: The agreement between ANRES and INAAREES will facilitate the exchange of external evaluators and the recognition of academic degrees.

item.title: Príncipe islanders face rising home and shop robberies
item.description: Residents report stolen cash, phones, and even potatoes amid growing insecurity on the island.

item.title: Sao Tome and Principe bans plastic bags
item.description: Law 8/2020 prohibits production, import, sale, and free distribution of plastic bags.
